CC.D-1 Resolution Warrant Register #1285
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
GENERAL FUND RESERVE POLICY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution which establishes a General Fund Reserve Policy and distribution of fund balance as indicated in this staff report.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 09-4780 AND ADOPT A RESOLUTION TO AMEND THE PARKING PENALTY FEE SCHEDULE TO OFFSET TRIAL COURT OPERATION SURCHARGE COSTS IMPOSED UPON THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council rescind Resolution No. 09-4780 and adopt a new resolution amending the Parking Violation Penalty Schedule to include the trial court operation surcharge as established by SB 857.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF ESTABLISHING A NEW DEADLINE FOR PROPOSALS FOR BUILDING AND SAFETY SERVICES AND CHANGING THE COMPOSITION OF THE AD HOC COMMITTEE
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) direct Staff to re-advertise the Request for Proposals and publish the RFP in the San Gabriel Valley Tribune, Los Angeles Times, Highlander and relevant trade publications, directly invite proposals from the firms that had submitted proposals for building and safety services in 2009, and set the deadline for proposals for December 9, 2010 at 5:00 p.m.; and 2) discuss and provide direction on the composition of the Ad Hoc Committee.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE INCREASING THE TIME LIMITS FOR FOOD VENDOR TRUCKS TO PARK IN ONE LOCATION
It is recommended that the City Council 1) Introduce the attached Ordinance extending the time limits for food vendor trucks to park and do business at any one location; and 2) Read the Ordinance by title only and waive further reading.
E-6
REVIEW AND DISCUSS THE CITY ATTORNEY AGREEMENT APPROVED ON OCTOBER 26, 2010 (Council Member House).
Council Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff with direction.
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
